about: Brain lines (the first 12 hex characters of the sha256 of the trimmed line) that brain-leak-check.mjs lets a public file share, because that file is the line's home and the brain restates it: an op description, a prompting tip, a provider's own example, the manual. Every pin below was in its public file at d534f39, the commit the brain left this repo (checked 2026-10-25). Pin a line only when the public file is its home; text pasted from the brain moves to slates-api instead. The check warns on a pin that no longer matches.
